mentions.name: Arkel
mentions.description: Arkel is an object store built as an S3 alternative for self-hosters who need reliable backup storage without depending on big-tech cloud providers. It has been in development and testing for several months.
mentions.problem: Self-hosters who are paranoid about backups want S3-style storage but want to avoid increasing reliance on big tech.
mentions.audience: Self-hosters and users looking to decrease their reliance on big-tech cloud providers.
mentions.source_excerpt: Arkel is an object store I've been building and testing for the past few months. https://arkeldata.com
